name: Neha Rao
source: An aspiring fashion designer, Neha loves making her own clothes and other’s clothes. She spends countless hours designing seasonal collections and actually sells them to the students of Arlington (at a very high price!) She uses Karolina as her main model and is Axel’s official stylist for his concerts and photoshoots. Rather reserved and cold, Neha can, however, be surprisingly friendly… whenever Karolina isn’t around.
